No first purchase

Free sign-ups that never pay

People who love the free training but aren’t ready for 1:1 have no small yes to give. They watch, they enjoy it, and they leave with their wallet closed.

No buyer signal

Watchers and buyers look the same

A free opt-in tells you someone is curious, not that they will invest. Without a paid step, the people ready for 1:1 are mixed in with everyone else.

No ads

Growth depends on today’s post

Every new lead comes from organic reach. With nothing on the front end that earns money, there is no way to turn ad spend into new 1:1 clients profitably.

Your free training is doing the hard part. Right now, everyone who isn’t ready for 1:1 leaves it with nothing to buy.

Script 1 · “Three months in”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Three months of great dates and still no ‘what are we’? Here’s what’s usually going on.”

Body

“Most people wait for the other person to bring it up, because asking feels like pressure. But clarity isn’t pressure. There are signs early on that show whether something is heading towards commitment, and there are calm ways to ask.”

CTA

“I put all of it into a $27 kit: five short lessons and the exact scripts. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera, soft white room, text on screen “clarity isn’t pressure”.

Script 2 · “The high-achiever gap”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Why do so many high achievers have total clarity at work, and none in dating?”

Body

“At work there’s a plan, a filter and a next step. In dating, most people just hope. When you bring the same intention to dating, you stop giving months to people who aren’t sure.”

CTA

“My Commitment Clarity Kit shows you how. Five lessons, a workbook, $27. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to the kit mock-up on screen.

Script 3 · “Lean in or let go”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here’s a quick way to tell if a connection has real potential.”

Body

“Ask three questions: Are they consistent? Do they make plans ahead? Do they talk about the future with you in it? It’s the start of the Potential Scorecard I use, and it makes ‘lean in or let go’ a lot easier.”

CTA

“The full scorecard is in my $27 Clarity Kit. Tap Learn more to get it.”
